query_results.query: Why are high-temperature sensors useful in electrified aircraft systems?
query_results.answer: High-temperature sensors are useful in electrified aircraft systems because they can detect and respond to high-grade waste heat generated in motors, batteries, and power electronics, which can be dangerous or inefficient if not identified early. They also help improve safety by providing warnings before off-nominal conditions become catastrophic, and they support battery failure analysis and prognostics to avoid runaway reactions and catastrophic ignition.
